fixes: Restore individual native toolbar command states after startup-time handle recreation; retain restrictions on the Downloads tab.
Replay captured startup book rows when restoring the language filter, including publisher series; do not start a second database reader.
Skip the first identical Apply after the global deletion checkbox already refreshed Search. Changed criteria and later Apply still query.
Explain an empty favorite-author set in the search status and clarify that author text is optional and book favorites are separate.

limits: Native scenarios use tiny isolated fixtures. Absolute launch timings are not representative of a quiet machine: CPU utilization was observed at 100% during this run.
The session-suite wrapper now permits 180 seconds for eight fresh child processes. Each child guard and the 15-second deferred-load guard are unchanged.
The SQL assertion counts the row SELECT separately from its count-query preparation.
No image-free export feature or ALReader update was implemented in this follow-up.
